dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm guessing people who sew, like you, must be really patient?

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Ah... So you're saying the patience needed for sewing and mending clothes is my real talent? That makes perfect sense... Huh. Why didn't I realize that sooner?

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: As for my battle skills and all that... I'm lacking in that area now, sure. But as long as I stay determined and patient, I'll pass the selection one day.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: A Lightkeeper who's both good at fighting and a patient sort... Heh, look out, Piramida, here I come!
